claim: Existing careers can use World > Expand career world in the current UI.
limitations: Archived source excerpts, not a fresh browser observation or an automated semantic proof. The independent checker must inspect the full current component and API before judging current behavior.

excerpts.text: - **Explicit world upgrade:** existing careers, including version 2, require **World > Expand career world**. The guard uses `WORLD_VERSION`; a current-version career is unchanged. A named **Before world expansion** checkpoint commits independently before transactional expansion and remains available after rollback. New memberships and structural changes activate next season once a calendar exists; only 1 July without fixtures permits immediate activation. Current-season memberships and fixtures are preserved. Deployment does not automatically expand a career or redraw its calendar.
